# All Yono Official

> All Yono Official (allyonoofficial.com) is an independent directory of Yono-network Android game apps: rummy, slots, spin and bingo titles. Each listing shows the download page the app currently uses, login notes and safety notes, alongside guides on APK safety, links, referral codes and scams. It is not the official website of any listed app and is not affiliated with SBI or YONO by SBI.

All Yono Official does not own, operate, or control any listed app, and does not process registrations, deposits, or withdrawals. Content is for adults (18+). Online money games are prohibited in India under the Promotion and Regulation of Online Gaming Act, 2025, in force since 1 May 2026. Some download links are referral links and are disclosed on each app page. Nothing on the site is legal or financial advice.

## Key pages

- [All Apps (A–Z)](https://allyonoofficial.com/most-rated-apps/): Every listed app, alphabetically. No rankings, star ratings or bonus ordering.
- [Rummy Apps](https://allyonoofficial.com/rummy-apps/)
- [Slot Games](https://allyonoofficial.com/slot-games/)
- [Spin Games](https://allyonoofficial.com/spin-games/)
- [Bingo Apps](https://allyonoofficial.com/bingo-apps/)
- [App Checker](https://allyonoofficial.com/app-checker/): Look up whether a specific app is currently listed.
- [Blog & Guides](https://allyonoofficial.com/blog/): Per-app guides and safety articles.

## Individual app pages

Each app has a page at `/{app-slug}/` (e.g. `/rummy77/`) with its current download page, login notes, safety notes and `SoftwareApplication` structured data. The full set is in [sitemap.xml](https://allyonoofficial.com/sitemap.xml).
